faqs.question: Does the payroll support the WPS bank file for Oman and the GCC?
faqs.answer: Yes. The payroll engine calculates salaries to your structure and exports the WPS / SIF file in the format your bank requires. We also handle gratuity and end-of-service calculations, and the layout can be adjusted as regulations change since you own the system.

faqs.question: How secure is the document vault?
faqs.answer: Documents are encrypted at rest and access is controlled per file by role, so a line manager only sees their own team's records. Every view, upload, and download is logged in a tamper-evident audit trail, which makes internal and external audits straightforward.

faqs.question: Can staff use it in Arabic?
faqs.answer: The entire portal is bilingual Arabic and English with full right-to-left support. Each employee can switch to their preferred language, and payslips and notifications follow that choice.

faqs.question: Will it remind us before visas and IDs expire?
faqs.answer: Yes. The system tracks passport, visa, resident card, and contract expiry dates and sends automated WhatsApp and email reminders ahead of each deadline, with an HR dashboard that escalates anything approaching its expiry.

faqs.question: Do we own the system, or is there a per-employee licence?
faqs.answer: You fully own the code, the database, and the documentation — there is no per-seat or per-employee licence to renew. Add unlimited staff without your costs changing, and your team can run and extend the portal independently.
